title: O Lord, Be Gracious to Us

questions.question: Woe to you, destroyer, who yourself have not been what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 33:1 (ESV): "Woe to you, destroyer, who yourself have not been destroyed,"

questions.question: O LORD, be gracious to us; we wait for you. Be our arm every morning, our salvation in the time of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 33:2 (ESV): "our salvation in the time of trouble."

questions.question: The LORD is exalted, for he dwells on high; he will fill Zion with justice and what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 33:5 (ESV): "he will fill Zion with justice and righteousness."

questions.question: And he will be the stability of your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge; the fear of the LORD is Zion's what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 33:6 (ESV): "the fear of the LORD is Zion's treasure."

questions.question: Now I will arise, says the LORD, now I will lift myself up; now I will be what?
The sinners in Zion are afraid; trembling has seized the godless: "Who among us can dwell with the consuming what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 33:14 (ESV): "Who among us can dwell with the consuming fire?"

questions.question: He who walks righteously and speaks uprightly... he will dwell on the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 33:15-16 (ESV): "he will dwell on the heights;"

questions.question: His place of defense will be the fortresses of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 33:16 (ESV): "his place of defense will be the fortresses of rocks;"

questions.question: Your eyes will behold the king in his beauty; they will see a land that stretches where?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 33:17 (ESV): "they will see a land that stretches afar."

questions.question: Look upon Zion, the city of our appointed feasts! Your eyes will see Jerusalem, an untroubled what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 33:20 (ESV): "Your eyes will see Jerusalem, an untroubled habitation,"

questions.question: For there the LORD in majesty will be for us a place of broad rivers and streams, where no galley with oars can go, nor majestic ship can do what?
For the LORD is our judge; the LORD is our lawgiver; the LORD is our whom; he will save us.
questions.explanation: Isaiah 33:22 (ESV): "the LORD is our king; he will save us."

questions.question: Your cords hang loose; they cannot hold the mast firm in its place or keep the sail spread. Then prey and spoil in abundance will be divided; even the lame will take the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 33:23 (ESV): "even the lame will take the prey."

questions.question: And no inhabitant will say, "I am sick"; the people who dwell there will be forgiven their what?
You will see no more the insolent people, the people of an obscure speech that you cannot comprehend, stammering in a tongue that you cannot what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 33:19 (ESV): "stammering in a tongue that you cannot understand."

key_verse_text: For the LORD is our judge; the LORD is our lawgiver; the LORD is our king; he will save us.
